hostConnectivity.title: Host connectivity
hostConnectivity.copy: Check each accessible host through the selected account’s proxy connection.
hostConnectivity.usernameHint: Enter an exact existing username, then resolve it before saving.
hostConnectivity.scheduledHint: Waits the configured interval after each completed batch.
hostConnectivity.maxRetriesHint: 0–10 retries after the initial failed check. Default: 10. Zero disables retries.
hostConnectivity.retryIntervalHint: Wait 1–60 seconds after a failure before retrying. Default: 1.
hostConnectivity.probeUrlHint: A successful HTTPS response confirms connectivity. Redirects and embedded URL credentials are refused.
hostConnectivity.saveBeforeRun: Save these changes before running a check.
hostConnectivity.invalidDraft: Resolve the selected username and check the interval, timeout, retry settings, and HTTPS URL before saving.
hostConnectivity.invalidConfig: Use a valid HTTPS URL, an interval of 60–86,400 seconds, a timeout of 1–60 seconds, 0–10 retries, and a retry delay of 1–60 seconds.
hostConnectivity.resolveRequired: Resolve this exact username before saving.
hostConnectivity.stale: These results are stale because the current subscription could not be loaded.
hostConnectivity.noHosts: No accessible hosts are available yet. Select an account and run a check.
hostConnectivity.historyHint: Each host check’s final result is retained for 24 hours, after any retries.
hostConnectivity.noHistory: No checks in the last 24 hours.
hostConnectivity.loadFailed: Connectivity results could not be loaded.
hostConnectivity.checkFailed: The connectivity check could not be completed.
hostConnectivity.resolveFailed: The test account could not be resolved.
hostConnectivity.saveFailed: Connectivity configuration could not be saved.
hostConnectivity.historyFailed: Check history could not be loaded.
